The agent did ask for confirmation twice, and the customer's own words show it had already used the first branch ("I'm not confirming an exchange for the water bottle"). But at the explicit "yes" request it agreed to the lamp exchange when it should have switched to returning the water bottle. That is the first decisive deviation, and the extra exchange write plus the missing return follow from it. By then the agent had already found order #W6390527, the water bottle's item ID, and the only payment method (paypal_7644869). Its earlier slips were recovered from, and it did not remind the customer to confirm the full list of items to exchange, but the customer had already said "nothing else", so that lapse was not decisive. A faithful customer saying "don't exchange, return the water bottle instead" would very likely have led to the gold return call.
